semiconductor_relevance: High — Shanghai Shengjian Technology provides green technology solutions and auxiliary equipment specifically for the semiconductor industry, contributing to environmentally sustainable production.
summary: Shanghai Shengjian Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in green technology services for the semiconductor industry, offering solutions for factory monitoring, waste control, and effluent management. The company supports high-tech enterprises in integrated circuits and semiconductor displays, focusing on enhancing environmental sustainability in production processes.

regional_presence.China: The company is well-established in China's high-tech industry and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange.
